$comment: Contract for the CreateUser server-side command (AD-003, AD-041, AD-044). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_CreateUser). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_CreateUser
customApi.description: An administrator adds a person to the application user registry (al_user), keyed on work email (AD-010). Enforces the AD-041 permission.manage Manage permission, upserts on the work email (idempotent) and writes an immutable Audit Event (BR-012).

requestParameters.name: WorkEmail
requestParameters.description: The person's work email. This is the stable user identifier and the alternate key.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same user.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when the command was rejected for a conflict.
